passages.text: The visitors' bus is delayed by a traffic jam on the main road outside town. Rows of cars are hardly moving, so the driver checks an alternative route before changing direction. At the next junction, the map tells him to turn right towards the river bridge. A helper phones our school to explain the delay and give a new arrival time. We move the welcome game indoors and keep the first activity short enough for the visitors. Good information lets both groups adjust calmly instead of worrying about an unexplained absence.

parallelText.en: The visitors' bus is delayed by a traffic jam on the main road outside town.
parallelText.zh: 来访者的公交车被城外主路的交通堵塞耽搁。

parallelText.en: Rows of cars are hardly moving, so the driver checks an alternative route before changing direction.
parallelText.zh: 一排排汽车几乎不动，因此司机先查看另一条路线再改变方向。

parallelText.en: At the next junction, the map tells him to turn right towards the river bridge.
parallelText.zh: 到下一个路口，地图指引他向右转，去河桥方向。

parallelText.en: A helper phones our school to explain the delay and give a new arrival time.
parallelText.zh: 助手给学校打电话，说明延误并告知新的到达时间。

parallelText.en: We move the welcome game indoors and keep the first activity short enough for the visitors.
parallelText.zh: 我们把欢迎游戏移到室内，并缩短第一个活动以照顾访客。

parallelText.en: Good information lets both groups adjust calmly instead of worrying about an unexplained absence.
parallelText.zh: 良好的信息让双方平静调整，而不必因原因不明的缺席担忧。

passages.text: At the village airport, our group watches a small plane prepare for its first flight of the day. A few pupils sketch its wings while the others note questions for the guide. We stay behind the marked line until the plane can take off safely. As it rises, Ben notices that his drawing shows the wheels but misses part of one wing. The guide lets us compare photographs afterwards instead of moving closer to the runway. We complete our notes and learn that careful viewing can continue without crossing a safety boundary.

parallelText.en: At the village airport, our group watches a small plane prepare for its first flight of the day.
parallelText.zh: 在村镇机场，我们小组看一架小飞机准备当天首飞。

parallelText.en: A few pupils sketch its wings while the others note questions for the guide.
parallelText.zh: 几位学生画机翼，其余人记下要问讲解员的问题。

parallelText.en: We stay behind the marked line until the plane can take off safely.
parallelText.zh: 我们待在标记线后，等飞机安全起飞。

parallelText.en: As it rises, Ben notices that his drawing shows the wheels but misses part of one wing.
parallelText.zh: 飞机升起时，本发现自己的画画出了轮子，却漏了一部分机翼。

parallelText.en: The guide lets us compare photographs afterwards instead of moving closer to the runway.
parallelText.zh: 之后讲解员让我们比较照片，而不是靠近跑道。

parallelText.en: We complete our notes and learn that careful viewing can continue without crossing a safety boundary.
parallelText.zh: 我们完成记录，也明白了不越安全界线同样能继续仔细观察。
